# Supported models

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_models_page.py from localm's own tables. Do not edit by hand. -->

localm runs models in these formats and roles. The lists below are the tables localm itself uses to decide what a model is, so this page and the program agree.

## Chat and text

- **GGUF:** every text architecture the bundled llama.cpp build `b12087` supports ([its list](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/b12087/src/llama-arch.cpp)), except the special roles below. Vision models load with their projector (`--mmproj`).
- **Hugging Face Transformers:** models whose `config.json` names an architecture ending in `ForCausalLM`, `ForConditionalGeneration`, `LMHeadModel`.
- **EXL2 and EXL3:** through ExLlama (Linux with an NVIDIA GPU, the `exllama` extra).
- **Diffusion language models (GGUF):** `dream`, `llada`, `llada-moe`, `rnd1`.
- **Multi-token prediction drafting (GGUF):** `bailingmoe3`, `cohere2moe`, `deepseek2`, `deepseek32`, `deepseek4`, `glm-dsa`, `glm4moe`, `glm5-next`, `hy_v3`, `mellum`, `mimo2`, `nemotron_h_moe`, `qwen35`, `qwen35moe`, `qwen3next`, `qwen4exp`, `step35`.

## Embeddings

- **GGUF:** `bert`, `eurobert`, `gemma-embedding`, `gemma-embedding2`, `jina-bert-v2`, `jina-bert-v3`, `llama-embed`, `modern-bert`, `neo-bert`, `nomic-bert`, `nomic-bert-moe`.

## Speech

- **Text to speech (GGUF):** `qwen3tts`.
- **Speech to text:** Whisper (the `voice` extra).

## Image and video

- **GGUF checkpoints:** `aura`, `cosmos`, `flux`, `hidream`, `hyvid`, `ltxv`, `lumina2`, `qwen_image`, `qwen_image21`, `sd1`, `sd3`, `sdxl`, `wan`, through the built-in stable-diffusion.cpp backend or ComfyUI.
- **Text encoders (GGUF):** `t5encoder`.

## Music

- **ACE-Step (GGUF components):** `acestep-dit`, `acestep-lm`, `acestep-text-enc`, `acestep-vae`.
